svg.title: How a listing travels. Eight stops: discover (search queries tuned to target roles and location, general, LinkedIn and ATS), extract (company, title, location, work mode, experience, dates, URLs), validate, deduplicate (against everything already seen, including the same job reposted through a different source), score (0 to 100), select resume (the right variant per role), draft (application answers and recruiter outreach, flagging what needs your judgement), track (SQLite with a full audit log). Validation throws out engineering roles, sales roles, support roles, senior postings, scams, MLM schemes, and listings with no working application route. The scam detector checks five signal families: payment required (registration or processing fee, deposits), too good to be true (guaranteed placement), MLM and network marketing, vague employer (company name confidential), and suspicious contact (WhatsApp or Telegram only). Each matched signal adds 20 to a confidence score and 40 or more flags the listing as a scam.
